run_train_one_epoch: run train_one_epoch to train a PyTorch model for one epoch with gradient accumulation and mixed precision
run_evaluate: run evaluate to assess a PyTorch model on a test data loader and return accuracy metrics
review_train_one_epoch: review the train_one_epoch function for gradient accumulation, learning rate scheduling, and loss scaler usage
review_evaluate: review the evaluate function for CrossEntropyLoss computation and top-1 and top-5 accuracy tracking
refactor_train_one_epoch: refactor train_one_epoch to customize the learning rate schedule or add custom logging to the log_writer
